content: pi0 uses flow matching (diffusion variant) over 50-step action chunks. Policy runs at 50 Hz, generates 50 actions, executes first 25, replans. Actions are delta poses (relative to chunk start). Input: VLM token sequence (language + image patches) + noisy action. Flow matching iteratively denoises the action chunk. pi0-FAST variant uses DCT tokenization for faster inference. LIBERO integration via openpi repo; docker eval wrapper provided.
